title: Step 1: Professional Profile Layout with Uploadable Banner & Photo

requirements.summary: Add uploadable full-width banner image at the top of ProfilePage with camera overlay and dark gradient fallback
acceptanceCriteria: A wide banner image area is visible at the top of the profile page
A camera/upload icon is shown on the banner that triggers a file input on click
Selecting an image file updates the displayed banner immediately (optimistic preview)
The uploaded banner is saved to the backend and persists across page reloads
When no banner is uploaded, a dark gradient placeholder is shown

file_operations.description: Add a full-width banner section at the top of the profile page with a height of approximately 180px. Display the uploaded banner image using ExternalBlob.getDirectURL() when available, or fall back to a dark gradient background (e.g., from-gray-900 to-gray-800). Include a camera icon overlay button positioned in the top-right or bottom-right corner of the banner that triggers a hidden file input on click. On file selection, convert the file to Uint8Array, create an ExternalBlob using ExternalBlob.fromBytes(), and call the useUpdateBanner mutation hook with optimistic preview. Use the blob-storage component to handle the upload; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing. Ensure the banner renders above the existing avatar and profile info sections.

Add a `useUpdateBanner` mutation hook that accepts an ExternalBlob parameter and calls `actor.setBannerImage(blob)`. Include error handling and invalidate the `['bannerImage']` query key on success to refetch the banner. Ensure the mutation supports optimistic updates by temporarily displaying the new banner before backend confirmation.

requirements.summary: Replace the gradient initials avatar with an uploadable circular profile photo that overlaps the banner bottom edge
acceptanceCriteria: Profile photo is displayed as a circle overlapping the banner bottom edge
A camera icon overlay on the avatar triggers a file picker on click
Selecting an image updates the avatar preview immediately
The uploaded profile photo persists after page reload
Falls back to gradient initials avatar when no photo is set

file_operations.description: Modify the existing AvatarPlaceholder component rendering to position it absolutely at the bottom edge of the banner (e.g., bottom: -40px or transform: translateY(50%)) with left padding alignment. Wrap the avatar in a relative-positioned container and add a small camera icon overlay in the bottom-right corner of the circle. On camera icon click, trigger a hidden file input. On file selection, convert the file to Uint8Array, create an ExternalBlob using ExternalBlob.fromBytes(), and call the useUpdateProfilePhoto mutation hook with optimistic preview. Use the blob-storage component to handle the upload; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing. Ensure the AvatarPlaceholder component receives the profile photo ExternalBlob as the `imageUrl` or `avatarUrl` prop and falls back to gradient initials when null.

Add a `useUpdateProfilePhoto` mutation hook that accepts an ExternalBlob parameter and calls `actor.updateProfilePhoto(blob)`. Include error handling and invalidate the `['currentUserProfile']` query key on success to refetch the user profile with the new photo. Support optimistic updates to display the new photo immediately.

requirements.summary: Redesign profile info section with professional dark-theme layout including name in golden-glow box, handle, and stats (Followers, Following, Posts) in a horizontal row
acceptanceCriteria: Display name is shown inside a dark rounded box with a visible golden glow/shadow
@handle is shown in smaller muted text below the name
Followers count is displayed in a golden-bordered box with a golden drop-shadow
Following count and Posts count are displayed as labelled stats in a horizontal row
Edit Profile button is visible and correctly positioned on own profile
Layout is clean, professional, and consistent with the dark golden theme of the app

file_operations.description: Redesign the profile info section below the avatar: (1) Wrap the display name in a dark rounded pill container (e.g., bg-gray-900/80 rounded-full px-6 py-2) with a golden box-shadow (e.g., shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(251,191,36,0.5)]). (2) Display the @handle in smaller muted grey text (text-sm text-gray-400) directly below the name box. (3) Create a horizontal flexbox row for stats with three items: Followers (existing golden box with border-amber-500 and shadow-amber-500/50), Following count (fetched via useGetFollowing), and Posts count (from userProfile.postCount). Each stat should have a label and value in a consistent dark rounded box style. (4) Keep the existing Edit Profile button aligned to the right of the header area. Ensure spacing and alignment are clean and professional, matching the dark golden theme.

Add a `useGetFollowing` query hook that returns the following list for the current user by calling `actor.getFollowing(identity.getPrincipal())`. Extract the array length to display the Following count. Ensure the hook is disabled when the actor or identity is not available. Use query key `['following', principalString]` for caching.
